content:
ana: Quick planning thread for the launch week playbook. Scope: 3 posts (teaser social, Product Hunt mini, benchmark clip), 1 live webinar (Thu), and an inbound routing + credit experiment. Goals: signups -> activation (7-day), measure token spend and latency lift.

ben: Channel plan: Twitter (X) teaser & demo clip, LinkedIn long-form benchmark, Product Hunt post midday Thu. Use UTMs: ?utm_source=launch&utm_medium={channel}&utm_campaign=sprout. Can we get short links?

chris: I'll build the UTM generator. For Product Hunt we need a 90s benchmark clip and a one-paragraph narrative: "how batching + prefix caching cut cost 3x". Keep numbers concrete. Also we should surface a single "cost per generated prompt" KPI.

ana: (typo) ana: @chris yes. For the credit experiment: split 50/50 A/B where A = immediate 1000 credits on signup, B = gated 500 on email confirm + 1000 on first successful request. Measure activation rate at 24h and 7d. Segment rules suggestion: only apply to new accounts and email domains not in blocklist.

chris: Pseudocode for Segment rule:

```
if (traits.account_age_days <= 7 && traits.requests_total == 0 && !traits.email.endsWith('@partner.com')) {
  assign_webhook('/hooks/grant-starter', {user_id: id, amount: 1000})
}
```

ben: For gated flow variant B we need to ensure debounce + idempotency. Also append UTM param "variant=B" so analytics ties back.

sophia: Webinar flow: landing page -> register -> invite confirmation email (include 500 trial credits on confirm for variant B only) -> reminder 1h before. Attendees get extra 1500 after survey. Non-attenders get 300 after 48h if they watch recording. Route high-fit leads to SDR when company_size >= 50 or library_users > 10.

ana: small correction: company_size >= 50 OR MRR_estimate >= 5k. Add that rule to the SDR webhook payload.

dev-bot: staging hooks deployed: /hooks/grant-starter, /hooks/grant-onconfirm, /hooks/sdr-route. Test run IDs: hook_test_42, hook_test_43. Logs: https://ops.internal/tests/hook_test_42 :white_check_mark:

chris: Creative ask: benchmark clip script (90s) + 3 caption variants for X and LI. Sophia can we pair a short customer quote for PH?

sophia: I'll check with CX, might have a quote from the beta that mentions latency drop. If not, we'll use anonymized metric.

ana: Tracking matrix (high level): impressions, click-through, signups, confirmed emails, activated (first successful request), tokens used, cost per activation. Need dashboards for 24h/7d windows.

ben: I can wire the GA/BigQuery event names. Use event: launch_signup, launch_confirm, launch_activation, launch_webinar_attend. Add variant tag.

ana: Action items: ben -> shortlinks + UTMs; chris -> Segment rules + webhook idempotency tests; sophia -> webinar survey + CX quote; dev-bot -> verify hooks + provide logs; ana -> finalize post copy A/B for caption variants. Check-in tomorrow 11am PT. :sparkles:
